question.text: Cat III AIFs operating from IFSC (GIFT City) enjoy which indirect tax benefit?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.7, Cat III AIFs in IFSC are exempt from GST, enabling competitive offshore-style platforms. The Trap: Standard GST rates apply outside IFSC. Cross-Exam Context: Key attractor for Cat III AIFs in GIFT City. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Pitch IFSC as GST-neutral for foreign-investor-targeted Cat III AIFs.
